quote: Venus alone is auspicious. The combination of Venus and Mars causes Rajayoga. Jupiter and the Moon are evil.

consequent.text: Key-planet roles for Aries lagna: functional benefic/malefic, Rajayoga-producing and Maraka behaviour per Raman.

quote: Saturn, Mercury and Venus are ill-disposed. Jupiter and the Sun are auspicious. The mere combination of Jupiter and Saturn produces no beneficial results. Jupiter is the Yogakaraka or the planet producing success. If Venus becomes a Maraka he will not kill the native but planets like Saturn will bring about death to the person.

consequent.text: Key-planet roles for Cancer lagna: functional benefic/malefic, Rajayoga-producing and Maraka behaviour per Raman.

quote: Venus and Mercury are evil. Jupiter and Mars give beneficial results. Mars is the Rajayogakamka (conferer of name and fame). The combination of Mars and Jupiter also causes Rajayoga (combination for political success). The Sun does not kill the person although possessed of Maraka powers. Venus and other inauspicious planets kill the native.

consequent.text: Key-planet roles for Capricorn lagna: functional benefic/malefic, Rajayoga-producing and Maraka behaviour per Raman.

quote: Venus is the most powerful planet and in conjunction with Mercury produces Rajayoga. Mars, Jupiter and the Moon are evil.

consequent.text: Key-planet roles for Gemini lagna: functional benefic/malefic, Rajayoga-producing and Maraka behaviour per Raman.

quote: Mars, Jupiter and the Sun are evil. Venus alone is most beneficial and in conjunction with Saturn in good signs produces an excellent career of much fame. Combination of Saturn and Jupiter produces similar results as in Aries* Venus and Mercury when well associated cause Rajayoga. The Moon will not kill the person even though possessed of death-inflicting powers*

consequent.text: Key-planet roles for Leo lagna: functional benefic/malefic, Rajayoga-producing and Maraka behaviour per Raman.

quote: conjunction of Jupiter and Mars in favourable houses produce Rajayoga. Saturn, Venus and Mercury are evil. Saturn does not kill the native when he has the Maraka power but Mercury and other evil planets inflict death when they get Maraka powers.

consequent.text: Key-planet roles for Libra lagna: functional benefic/malefic, Rajayoga-producing and Maraka behaviour per Raman.

quote: Saturn alone causes Rajayoga. Jupiter, the Sun and Mars are inauspicious. Mercury and Saturn produce good. The conjunction of the Moon and Mercury produce Rajayoga. Mars himself will not kill the person. Jupiter, Venus and Mars when possessed of Maraka powers certainly kill the native.

consequent.text: Key-planet roles for Pisces lagna: functional benefic/malefic, Rajayoga-producing and Maraka behaviour per Raman.

quote: The Moon and Mars are auspicious. Mars is most powerful. Mars with the Moon or Jupiter causes Rajayoga. Saturn, Venus, the Sun and Mercury are evil. Mars himself does not kill the person even if he is a Maraka.

consequent.text: Key-planet roles for Sagittarius lagna: functional benefic/malefic, Rajayoga-producing and Maraka behaviour per Raman.

quote: Mars is the best planet and in conjunction with Jupiter produces much good- The Sun and Mars also produce good. Venus is evil. When the Sun and Mars combine together they produce Rajayoga. Saturn does not bring about death even when he is a Maraka. But Venus causes death when he gets jurisdiction as a Maraka planet.

consequent.text: Key-planet roles for Scorpio lagna: functional benefic/malefic, Rajayoga-producing and Maraka behaviour per Raman.

quote: Jupiter is beneficial. The Sun and the Moon produce Rajayoga. Mercury and Venus are evil. Jupiter, even if he becomes a Maraka does not inflict death.

consequent.text: Key-planet roles for Taurus lagna: functional benefic/malefic, Rajayoga-producing and Maraka behaviour per Raman.

quote: Saturn is the most auspicious and powerful planet. Jupiter, Venus and the Moon are evil planets. Saturn alone produces Rajayoga.

consequent.text: Key-planet roles for Virgo lagna: functional benefic/malefic, Rajayoga-producing and Maraka behaviour per Raman.

quote: Venus alone is most powerful. Mercury and Venus when combined together cause Rajayoga. Mars and the Moon are evil. The Sun does not kill the native even if he becomes a Maraka but Venus, the Moon and Jupiter will inflict death when they are possessed of death-inflicting power.
